description: BEFORE recommending or installing any package, check it here. The response carries `agent_action`: REFUSE (do not add it — relay the `because` text to the user), CONFIRM (ask the user first), or PROCEED. A failed or rate-limited call also answers REFUSE; never proceed unchecked. Also returns the underlying advisories, slop risk, and KEV status as supporting data.

version.description: Optional version. If supplied, range matching is applied.

name: vdb_check_package
